AddAITemplate.title: Add AI template
AddAITemplate.summary: Adds an AI template for automated review and smart thumbnail tasks.

AddCategory.title: Create a category
AddCategory.summary: Creates a category to classify audio, video, image, and short video materials stored in ApsaraVideo VOD, making resource discovery and management more efficient.

AddEditingProject.title: Create an online editing project
AddEditingProject.summary: Creates an online editing project (video editing task).

AddEditingProjectMaterials.title: Add materials to an online editing project
AddEditingProjectMaterials.summary: Adds one or more materials to an online editing project.

AddTranscodeTemplateGroup.title: Create a transcoding template group
AddTranscodeTemplateGroup.summary: Adds transcoding configurations. You can create a transcoding template group or add transcoding templates to a specified template group.

AddVodDomain.title: Add an accelerated domain name
AddVodDomain.summary: Adds a domain name for CDN acceleration in ApsaraVideo VOD.

AddVodStorageForApp.title: Bind storage to a sub-application
AddVodStorageForApp.summary: Binds a storage bucket to a sub-application of ApsaraVideo VOD.

AddVodTemplate.title: Add a snapshot or animated image template
AddVodTemplate.summary: Adds a snapshot or animated image template.

AddWatermark.title: Add an image or text watermark template
AddWatermark.summary: To simplify watermark task processing, ApsaraVideo VOD consolidates complex watermark parameters such as position, size, font, and color into templates, each identified by a unique watermark template ID. Calls this operation to add an image or text watermark template.

AttachAppPolicyToIdentity.title: Attach application authorization to an identity entity
AttachAppPolicyToIdentity.summary: Invokes this operation to attach access permissions of an ApsaraVideo VOD application to a specified identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role).

BatchGetMediaInfos.title: Batch retrieve media asset information
BatchGetMediaInfos.summary: Retrieves the basic information and source file information of multiple media assets in a batch.

BatchSetVodDomainConfigs.title: Batch configure domain names
BatchSetVodDomainConfigs.summary: Configures multiple accelerated domain names in a batch.

BatchStartVodDomain.title: Enable an accelerated domain name
BatchStartVodDomain.summary: Enables an accelerated domain name that is in the Disabled state.

CancelUrlUploadJobs.title: Cancel URL upload tasks
CancelUrlUploadJobs.summary: Cancels URL upload tasks that are in the queue.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: Transfer a resource to another resource group
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Transfers a resource to a different resource group.

CreateAudit.title: Manual review
CreateAudit.summary: Submits a manual review request to review media information such as videos and audio files.

CreateUploadAttachedMedia.title: Obtain the upload URL and credential for an auxiliary media asset
CreateUploadAttachedMedia.summary: The upload URL and credential are provided by ApsaraVideo VOD to address authorization and security concerns, prevent malicious uploads, and enable automatic creation of a media asset ID (MediaId) for management and processing. For auxiliary media assets such as watermarks and subtitles, invoke this operation to obtain the upload credential and create the corresponding media asset information.

CreateUploadImage.title: Retrieve upload URL and credential for image upload
CreateUploadImage.summary: Retrieves the upload URL and upload credential for uploading an image to ApsaraVideo VOD, and creates image information. ApsaraVideo VOD issues upload URLs and credentials to ensure authorization and security, prevent malicious uploads, and supports automatic creation of an image ID (ImageId) for management. You can invoke this operation to obtain the upload URL and credential and create image information.

CreateUploadVideo.title: Obtain the upload URL and credential for an audio or video file
CreateUploadVideo.summary: ApsaraVideo VOD issues the upload URL and upload credential to ensure authorization and security and prevent malicious uploads. During issuance, a media ID (MediaId), also called a video ID (VideoId), undergoes automatic creation for management. Invoke this operation to obtain the upload URL and upload credential, and create audio or video information.

DecryptKMSDataKey.title: Decrypt KMS data key ciphertext
DecryptKMSDataKey.summary: Invokes this operation to perform decryption on the CiphertextBlob in a KMS data key (DK).

DeleteAttachedMedia.title: Delete auxiliary media assets in batches
DeleteAttachedMedia.summary: Deletes one or more auxiliary media assets that have been uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD, such as watermark images, subtitle files, and materials.

DeleteCategory.title: Delete a category
DeleteCategory.summary: Deletes a category and its subcategories.

DeleteEditingProjectMaterials.title: Delete online editing project materials
DeleteEditingProjectMaterials.summary: Deletes materials from an online editing project.

DeleteImage.title: Delete images or video snapshots
DeleteImage.summary: Deletes images uploaded by users or images generated from video snapshots.

DeleteMessageCallback.title: Delete event notification configuration
DeleteMessageCallback.summary: Deletes the callback method, callback URL, and event types of an event notification.

DeleteMezzanines.title: Batch delete audio and video source files
DeleteMezzanines.summary: Deletes the source files of multiple audio and video files at a time.

DeleteMultipartUpload.title: Delete fragment files during upload
DeleteMultipartUpload.summary: Deletes fragment files generated during upload.

DeleteStream.title: Delete media streams
DeleteStream.summary: Deletes media stream (video stream or audio stream) information and storage files.

DeleteTranscodeTemplateGroup.title: Delete transcoding configurations
DeleteTranscodeTemplateGroup.summary: Deletes transcoding configurations. You can delete specific transcoding templates from a transcoding template group or force delete an entire transcoding template group.

DeleteVideo.title: Delete complete videos
DeleteVideo.summary: Deletes complete videos, including video source files, transcoded stream files, and thumbnails.

DeleteVodDomain.title: Delete an accelerated domain name
DeleteVodDomain.summary: Deletes an accelerated domain name that has been added for ApsaraVideo VOD.

DeleteVodSpecificConfig.title: Delete domain name configurations
DeleteVodSpecificConfig.summary: Deletes the configurations of a domain name for CDN acceleration in ApsaraVideo VOD.

DeleteWatermark.title: Delete a watermark template
DeleteWatermark.summary: Deletes an image watermark template or text watermark template by watermark template ID.

DescribeMediaDistribution.title: Query media asset distribution
DescribeMediaDistribution.summary: Queries the time-based distribution of audio and video media assets. The maximum time span between the start time and end time is six months.

DescribePlayTopVideos.title: Query top video playback statistics
DescribePlayTopVideos.summary: Retrieves daily playback statistics for top videos, including the number of views, unique viewers, and total playback duration.

DescribePlayUserAvg.title: Query average playback statistics
DescribePlayUserAvg.summary: Retrieves daily average playback statistics for a specified time range, including average playback duration and average playback count.

DescribePlayUserTotal.title: Query total playback statistics
DescribePlayUserTotal.summary: Retrieves the total daily playback statistics within a specified time range, including total play count, total unique viewers, total playback duration, and playback duration distribution.

DescribePlayVideoStatis.title: Query playback statistics for a single video
DescribePlayVideoStatis.summary: Queries the daily playback statistics of a specified video within a specified time range. The statistics include total playback duration, number of playbacks, number of unique viewers, and playback duration distribution.

DescribeVodAIData.title: Query AI processing usage data
DescribeVodAIData.summary: Queries usage data of AI processing services such as automated review and media fingerprint.

DescribeVodDomainBpsData.title: Query bandwidth
DescribeVodDomainBpsData.summary: Invokes this operation to query the bandwidth data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData operation, this operation supports a longer time range for historical data queries (up to 366 days) but provides a larger data time granularity (minimum of 5 minutes) and higher data latency.

DescribeVodDomainBpsDataByLayer.title: Query bandwidth by protocol
DescribeVodDomainBpsDataByLayer.summary: Queries bandwidth data of accelerated domain names by protocol type.

DescribeVodDomainCertificateInfo.title: Query domain name certificate
DescribeVodDomainCertificateInfo.summary: Retrieves the certificate information of a specified accelerated domain name.

DescribeVodDomainConfigs.title: Query domain name configurations
DescribeVodDomainConfigs.summary: Queries domain name configurations. You can query multiple feature configurations in a single request.

DescribeVodDomainDetail.title: Query domain name basic information
DescribeVodDomainDetail.summary: Retrieves the basic configuration information of a specified China domain name for video-on-demand (VOD) acceleration.

DescribeVodDomainHitRateData.title: Query byte hit ratio
DescribeVodDomainHitRateData.summary: Queries the byte hit ratio (percentage of hit bytes) of an accelerated domain name.

DescribeVodDomainLog.title: Query domain name logs
DescribeVodDomainLog.summary: Retrieves the download URLs of raw CDN access logs for a specified domain name.

DescribeVodDomainMax95BpsData.title: Query 95th percentile bandwidth
DescribeVodDomainMax95BpsData.summary: Queries the 95th percentile bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names.

DescribeVodDomainQpsData.title: Query QPS
DescribeVodDomainQpsData.summary: Queries the queries per second (QPS) of accelerated domain names at a 5-minute granularity. Data from the last 90 days is supported.

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData.title: Query real-time bandwidth
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData.summary: Invokes this operation to query the bandwidth data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainBpsData operation, this operation supports a smaller time granularity (minimum of 1 minute), lower data latency (minimum of 5 minutes), but a shorter historical data time range (up to 186 days).

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData.title: Query real-time byte hit ratio
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData.summary: Queries the byte hit rate data of accelerated domain names. This operation supports a minimum time granularity of 1 minute, with a data delay of at least 5 minutes, and allows you to query data from the last 186 days.

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeDetailData.title: Query real-time access details
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeDetailData.summary: Queries real-time access data for accelerated domain names, including QPS, bandwidth, and HTTP status code data within the last 7 days.

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.title: Query real-time HTTP status codes
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.summary: Queries the total number and proportion of HTTP status codes for an accelerated domain name. This operation supports a minimum data time granularity of 1 minute, with a data delay of at least 5 minutes, and allows you to query data from the last 186 days.

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeQpsData.title: Query real-time QPS
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeQpsData.summary: Invoke this operation to query the queries per second (QPS) data for access to an accelerated domain name. This operation supports a minimum data time granularity of 1 minute, with a data delay of at least 5 minutes, and allows you to query data from the last 186 days.

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.title: Query real-time request hit ratio
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.summary: Queries the request hit ratio data for an accelerated domain name. The minimum time granularity for data queried by this operation is 1 minute. The data latency is at least 5 minutes. You can query data for up to the last 186 days.

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData.title: Query real-time traffic
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData.summary: Invokes this operation to query the traffic data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainTrafficData operation, this operation supports a smaller time granularity (minimum of 1 minute), lower data latency (minimum of 5 minutes), but a shorter historical data range (up to 186 days).

DescribeVodDomainReqHitRateData.title: Query request hit ratio
DescribeVodDomainReqHitRateData.summary: Queries the request hit ratio (percentage of hit requests) of an accelerated domain name.

DescribeVodDomainSrcBpsData.title: Query back-to-origin bandwidth
DescribeVodDomainSrcBpsData.summary: Queries the back-to-origin bandwidth data of accelerated domain names.

DescribeVodDomainSrcTrafficData.title: Query back-to-origin traffic
DescribeVodDomainSrcTrafficData.summary: Queries the back-to-origin traffic data of accelerated domain names.

DescribeVodDomainTrafficData.title: Query traffic
DescribeVodDomainTrafficData.summary: Invokes this operation to query the traffic data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData operation, this operation supports a longer historical data query range (up to 366 days) but provides a larger data time granularity (minimum of 5 minutes) and higher data latency.

DescribeVodDomainUsageData.title: Query traffic and bandwidth usage
DescribeVodDomainUsageData.summary: Queries acceleration traffic or bandwidth usage data.

DescribeVodEditingUsageData.title: Query online editing usage data
DescribeVodEditingUsageData.summary: Queries the usage data of online editing in ApsaraVideo VOD.

DescribeVodMediaPlayData.title: Query audio and video playback statistics
DescribeVodMediaPlayData.summary: Retrieves playback data of an audio or video file on a specified date by media ID (audio or video ID), including the number of unique visitors, average plays per user, total plays, average play duration per user, and total play duration.

DescribeVodPlayerCollectData.title: Query player playback aggregated data
DescribeVodPlayerCollectData.summary: Queries aggregated playback data of the player.

DescribeVodPlayerDimensionData.title: Query player dimension metadata
DescribeVodPlayerDimensionData.summary: Queries the dimension metadata of the player.

DescribeVodRangeDataByLocateAndIspServic.title: Query access data by ISP and region
DescribeVodRangeDataByLocateAndIspServic.summary: Queries access data for an accelerated domain name by ISP or region, including bandwidth, average response rate, page views, cache hit ratio, and request hit ratio.

DescribeVodRefreshQuota.title: Query purge and prefetch quota and remaining count
DescribeVodRefreshQuota.summary: Queries the maximum number and remaining daily quota of URLs and directories for purge and prefetch operations.

DescribeVodRefreshTasks.title: Query purge and prefetch status
DescribeVodRefreshTasks.summary: Queries whether purge and prefetch tasks have taken effect.

DescribeVodSSLCertificateList.title: Query certificate list by domain name
DescribeVodSSLCertificateList.summary: Queries certificate list information by domain name.

DescribeVodStorageData.title: Query storage usage
DescribeVodStorageData.summary: Queries the usage of media asset management, including storage space and outbound storage traffic.

DescribeVodTieringStorageData.title: Query tiered storage usage
DescribeVodTieringStorageData.summary: Queries the usage of tiered storage for media asset management.

DescribeVodTieringStorageRetrievalData.title: Query tiered storage retrieval data
DescribeVodTieringStorageRetrievalData.summary: Queries the retrieval data usage of tiered storage in media asset management.

DescribeVodUserDomains.title: Query acceleration domain name list
DescribeVodUserDomains.summary: Queries the list of all acceleration domain names under your account for ApsaraVideo VOD.

DescribeVodUserVipsByDomain.title: Query node IP list - L1
DescribeVodUserVipsByDomain.summary: Queries the IP list of a domain name.

DescribeVodVerifyContent.title: Retrieve domain ownership verification content
DescribeVodVerifyContent.summary: Retrieves the domain ownership verification content.

DetachAppPolicyFromIdentity.title: Revoke application permissions from an identity entity
DetachAppPolicyFromIdentity.summary: Invokes this operation to revoke application authorization from a specified account identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role).

GenerateDownloadSecretKey.title: Generate a secure download key
GenerateDownloadSecretKey.summary: Generates a key for secure download. The secure download feature of ApsaraVideo Player SDK encrypts videos downloaded to local devices by using a key file. The encrypted videos can only be decrypted and played by using the key file generated by the unique app that is bindable in advance. This effectively protects video content and prevents downloaded videos from being maliciously played or distributed.

GenerateKMSDataKey.title: Create a KMS data key
GenerateKMSDataKey.summary: Invokes the operation to generate a random KMS data key (DK) for ApsaraVideo VOD HLS encryption.

GetAIImageJobs.title: Query AI image tasks
GetAIImageJobs.summary: Queries the list of AI image processing tasks.

GetAIMediaAuditJob.title: Query an automated review job
GetAIMediaAuditJob.summary: Queries an automated review job. After you submit an AI job, the job is processed asynchronously. You can call this operation to query job information in real time.

GetAIVideoTagResult.title: Retrieve smart tagging results
GetAIVideoTagResult.summary: Retrieves the results of smart tagging for a video.

GetAppInfos.title: Query application information
GetAppInfos.summary: Queries application information by application ID.

GetAppPlayKey.title: Retrieve application playback key
GetAppPlayKey.summary: Retrieves the playback key of an application.

GetAttachedMediaInfo.title: Batch retrieve auxiliary media asset information
GetAttachedMediaInfo.summary: Retrieves the basic information and access URLs of multiple auxiliary media assets in a batch by specifying their IDs after the assets such as watermark images, subtitle files, and materials are uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD.

GetAuditHistory.title: Retrieve manual review history
GetAuditHistory.summary: Retrieves the history of manual review records.

GetCategories.title: Query a category and its subcategories
GetCategories.summary: Invokes this operation to perform a filtered query for specified categorization information by ID or type, and retrieves the list of its subcategories (next-level categories).

GetDailyPlayRegionStatis.title: Query traffic data statistics by audio and video ID
GetDailyPlayRegionStatis.summary: Retrieves the full traffic data of media assets for a specified date and region. The data is generated based on CDN traffic logs and primarily reflects the traffic consumption of videos. The generated CSV file contains the following information: date, video ID, domain name, traffic, application ID, and category ID. You can download the file to your local machine for scenarios such as operational data analytics.

GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult.title: Query digital watermark extraction job
GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult.summary: Queries the results of a digital watermarking (copyright watermark or tracing watermark) extraction job, including the job status and the successfully extracted watermark text.

GetEditingProject.title: Get a single online editing project
GetEditingProject.summary: Retrieves the details of an online editing project (video editing task).

GetEditingProjectMaterials.title: Get online editing project materials
GetEditingProjectMaterials.summary: Retrieves the list of materials to be edited in an online editing project.

GetImageInfo.title: Retrieve information about a single image
GetImageInfo.summary: Retrieves the basic information and access URL of an image by image ID after the image is uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD.

GetImageInfos.title: Batch retrieve image information
GetImageInfos.summary: Queries the basic information and access URLs of multiple images by image ID after the images are uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD.

GetJobDetail.title: Get task details
GetJobDetail.summary: Queries the details of an asynchronous task by job ID.

GetMediaAiAnalysis.title: Retrieve video AI analysis results
GetMediaAiAnalysis.summary: Retrieves the results of video AI analysis.

GetMediaAuditAudioResultDetail.title: Get audio automated review result details
GetMediaAuditAudioResultDetail.summary: Retrieves the details of audio automated review results.

GetMediaAuditResult.title: Retrieve automated review result summary
GetMediaAuditResult.summary: Retrieves the summary of automated review results.

GetMediaAuditResultDetail.title: Get automated review result details
GetMediaAuditResultDetail.summary: Retrieves the details of automated review results. You can call this operation to query the details of review results in real time.

GetMediaAuditResultTimeline.title: Get automated review result timeline
GetMediaAuditResultTimeline.summary: Retrieves the timestamps of all screenshots that contain violations.

GetMediaDNAResult.title: Get media fingerprint results
GetMediaDNAResult.summary: Retrieves media fingerprint results. After a media fingerprint job is complete, you can call this operation to query the results in real time.

GetMediaRefreshJobs.title: Query video purge or prefetch task information
GetMediaRefreshJobs.summary: Queries task information such as task status and filtering policies for a video purge or prefetch task.

GetMessageCallback.title: Query event notification configurations
GetMessageCallback.summary: Queries the callback method, callback URL, and event types of event notifications.

GetMezzanineInfo.title: Retrieve source file information
GetMezzanineInfo.summary: Retrieves the source file information of an audio or video file, including the file URL, resolution, and bitrate.

GetPlayInfo.title: Retrieve audio or video playback URL
GetPlayInfo.summary: Retrieves the playback URL of an audio or video file by providing the audio or video ID, which can then be played using ApsaraVideo Player or a third-party player such as a system-native, open-source, or custom-built player.

GetTranscodeSummary.title: Query audio and video transcoding summaries
GetTranscodeSummary.summary: Queries video transcoding summary of one or more audio or video files by their IDs, including video transcoding status and transcoding progress.

GetTranscodeTask.title: Query transcoding task details
GetTranscodeTask.summary: Queries the details of transcoding jobs based on a transcoding task ID.

GetTranscodeTemplateGroup.title: Query transcoding configuration details
GetTranscodeTemplateGroup.summary: Queries the details of a transcoding configuration by transcoding template group ID.

GetUploadDetails.title: Retrieve media upload details
GetUploadDetails.summary: Retrieves media upload details by media ID, such as upload time, upload ratio, and upload source. Batch retrieval is supported.

GetVideoInfo.title: Retrieve information about a single audio or video file
GetVideoInfo.summary: Retrieves the information about a single audio or video file by audio or video ID, including the title, description, duration, thumbnail URL, status, creation time, size, snapshots, category, and tags.

GetVideoInfos.title: Batch retrieve audio and video information
GetVideoInfos.summary: Retrieves the information about multiple audio and video files at a time by audio or video ID, including the title, description, duration, thumbnail URL, status, creation time, size, snapshots, category, and tags.

GetVideoList.title: Retrieve audio and video information list
GetVideoList.summary: Retrieves a list of audio and video information.

GetVideoPlayAuth.title: Retrieve audio or video playback credential
GetVideoPlayAuth.summary: Retrieves the playback credential (PlayAuth) for an audio or video file. ApsaraVideo Player SDK uses this credential to automatically obtain the playback URL. Because the playback credential has a validity period and is bound to a specific audio or video file, it cannot be shared or reused. An expired or invalid credential will cause playback failure. This playback method is suitable for audio and video playback scenarios that require high security.

GetWatermark.title: Query a single watermark template
GetWatermark.summary: Invokes this operation to query the parameter settings of a single image watermark template or text watermark template by watermark template ID, including the position, size, and display time of image watermarks, and the content, font, color, and position of text watermarks.

GetWorkflowTask.title: Query workflow task execution information
GetWorkflowTask.summary: Queries the execution information of a workflow task.

ListAIImageInfo.title: Query smart thumbnail information
ListAIImageInfo.summary: Queries the AI image information of a specified video.

ListAIJob.title: Query intelligent tagging or media fingerprint jobs
ListAIJob.summary: Queries intelligent tagging or media fingerprint jobs. After you submit an intelligent tagging or media fingerprint job, the job is processed asynchronously. You can call this operation to query job information in real time.

ListAITemplate.title: Query AI templates
ListAITemplate.summary: Queries the list of AI templates.

ListAppInfo.title: Query application information list
ListAppInfo.summary: Queries a list of applications that you are authorized to access based on specified filter conditions.

ListAppPoliciesForIdentity.title: List application permissions granted to an identity entity
ListAppPoliciesForIdentity.summary: Invokes this operation to list the application permissions granted to a specified account identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role).

ListAuditSecurityIp.title: Retrieve review security IP list
ListAuditSecurityIp.summary: Retrieves the list of China Chinese review security IPs.

ListDynamicImage.title: Query animated image list
ListDynamicImage.summary: Queries the list of animated images for a video by video ID.

ListJobInfo.title: Query task list
ListJobInfo.summary: Queries the historical task list based on a media asset ID.

ListLiveRecordVideo.title: Retrieve live to VOD video list
ListLiveRecordVideo.summary: Retrieves the list of Live to VOD videos.

ListSnapshots.title: Query video snapshot data
ListSnapshots.summary: Queries snapshots generated by video snapshot jobs and thumbnail snapshots automatically generated by the system during video upload.

ListTranscodeTask.title: Query transcoding task list
ListTranscodeTask.summary: Queries the historical transcoding task information of an audio or video file by its ID. This operation does not return specific job details.

ListTranscodeTemplateGroup.title: Query transcoding configuration list
ListTranscodeTemplateGroup.summary: Queries the list of transcoding template configurations.

ListVodTemplate.title: Query snapshot template list
ListVodTemplate.summary: Queries the list of snapshot templates.

ListWatermark.title: Query watermark template list
ListWatermark.summary: Invokes this operation to query the parameter settings of all image watermark templates and text watermark templates that have been added in the current service region, including the position, size, and display time of image watermarks, and the content, font, color, position, and other parameter settings of text watermarks.

MoveAppResource.title: Migrate resources to a new application
MoveAppResource.summary: Invokes this operation to migrate resources such as media assets from one application to another. Application administrators can directly transfer resources. Resource Access Management (RAM) users or RAM roles must have write permissions on both the source and destination applications. Batch migration is supported.

PreloadVodObjectCaches.title: Prefetch cache
PreloadVodObjectCaches.summary: Prefetches content from the origin server to L2 Cache nodes so that the first access directly hits the cache, reducing the load on the origin server.

ProduceEditingProjectVideo.title: Produce videos
ProduceEditingProjectVideo.summary: Produces one or more videos into a finished video. You can submit source videos directly through the timeline parameter, or create an online editing project first and then submit it for production.

RefreshMediaPlayUrls.title: Submit an audio or video refresh or prefetch task
RefreshMediaPlayUrls.summary: Submits a refresh or prefetch task for audio or video files by audio or video ID.

RefreshUploadVideo.title: Refresh video upload credential
RefreshUploadVideo.summary: Refreshes the upload credential for a video file after the upload times out.

RefreshVodObjectCaches.title: Purge cache
RefreshVodObjectCaches.summary: Purges file content on nodes. Specifies URL content to purge on cache nodes, and supports batch URL purging.

RegisterMedia.title: Register media asset information
RegisterMedia.summary: Registers media assets. Existing media files stored in your own OSS bucket that is connected to ApsaraVideo VOD must be registered to generate the associated data required by VOD before you can use VOD features such as transcoding and snapshotting.

RestoreMedia.title: Restore media assets
RestoreMedia.summary: Restores media assets from frozen storage.

SearchEditingProject.title: Search online editing projects
SearchEditingProject.summary: Searches for online editing projects (video editing lists).

SearchMedia.title: Search media information
SearchMedia.summary: Searches for media asset information such as videos, audio files, and images produced by ApsaraVideo VOD. You can use this operation with the media asset search protocol to perform multi-dimensional searches in ApsaraVideo VOD, including specifying return fields, exact matching, fuzzy matching, multi-value queries, range queries, and sort fields.

SetAppPlayKey.title: Set application playback key
SetAppPlayKey.summary: Sets the playback key for an application.

SetAuditSecurityIp.title: Set review security IP addresses
SetAuditSecurityIp.summary: Sets the review security IP addresses.

SetCrossdomainContent.title: Update cross-domain file
SetCrossdomainContent.summary: Updates the content of the cross-domain file crossdomain.xml for ApsaraVideo VOD.

SetDefaultTranscodeTemplateGroup.title: Set default transcoding configuration
SetDefaultTranscodeTemplateGroup.summary: Sets the default transcoding template group configuration.

SetDefaultWatermark.title: Set default watermark template
SetDefaultWatermark.summary: Sets a specified watermark template as the default watermark template.

SetEditingProjectMaterials.title: Set online editing project materials
SetEditingProjectMaterials.summary: Sets the materials to be edited for an online editing project.

SetMessageCallback.title: Set event notification configurations
SetMessageCallback.summary: Sets the callback method, callback URL, and event types for event notifications.

SetVodDomainCertificate.title: Set domain certificate status and modify certificate information
SetVodDomainCertificate.summary: Configures whether the certificate feature is enabled for a specified domain name and modifies certificate information.

SetVodDomainSSLCertificate.title: Set VOD domain certificate
SetVodDomainSSLCertificate.summary: Sets whether the certificate feature is enabled for a specified domain name and updates the certificate information.

SubmitAIImageAuditJob.title: Submit an image automated review job
SubmitAIImageAuditJob.summary: Submits an automated review task for an image. The task is asynchronously executed after it is submitted. The task may not be complete when the response is returned.

SubmitAIImageJob.title: Submit AI image task
SubmitAIImageJob.summary: Submits an AI image processing task.

SubmitAIJob.title: Submit an intelligent tagging or media fingerprint job
SubmitAIJob.summary: Submits an intelligent tagging or media fingerprint job.

SubmitAIMediaAuditJob.title: Submit an automated review job for audio and video files
SubmitAIMediaAuditJob.summary: Submits an automated review job for audio and video files. The job is executed asynchronously after submission, and the job may not be complete when the response is returned.

SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob.title: Submit a digital watermark extraction job
SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob.summary: Submits a digital watermarking (copyright watermark or tracing watermark) extraction job to asynchronously extract a copyright watermark or tracing watermark.

SubmitDynamicImageJob.title: Submit a media animated image job
SubmitDynamicImageJob.summary: Submits a media animated image job for asynchronous processing.

SubmitPreprocessJobs.title: Preprocess a video for the China production studio
SubmitPreprocessJobs.summary: Transcodes a video by using a China Production Studio (China Production Studio) for preprocessing.

SubmitSnapshotJob.title: Submit a media snapshot job
SubmitSnapshotJob.summary: Submits a video snapshot job to start asynchronous snapshot processing.

SubmitTranscodeJobs.title: Submit a media transcoding job
SubmitTranscodeJobs.summary: Submits a media transcoding job to start asynchronous transcoding.

SubmitWorkflowJob.title: Submit a VOD workflow job
SubmitWorkflowJob.summary: Initiates a VOD workflow for a video.

UpdateAttachedMediaInfos.title: Batch update auxiliary media asset information
UpdateAttachedMediaInfos.summary: Batch updates the information of auxiliary media assets, such as title, description, tags, and category, by specifying the unique identifiers (IDs) of the auxiliary media assets that have been uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD, including watermarked images, subtitle files, and other materials.

UpdateCategory.title: Update a category
UpdateCategory.summary: Updates the name of a category.

UpdateEditingProject.title: Modify an online editing project
UpdateEditingProject.summary: Modifies an online editing project (video editing task).

UpdateImageInfos.title: Batch update image information
UpdateImageInfos.summary: Batch modifies the title, description, tags, and category information of images by image ID after the images are uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD.

UpdateMediaStorageClass.title: Modify media asset storage class
UpdateMediaStorageClass.summary: Modifies the storage class of a media asset.

UpdateTranscodeTemplateGroup.title: Modify transcoding configurations
UpdateTranscodeTemplateGroup.summary: Modifies transcoding configurations. You can modify the configuration of a specified transcoding template in a transcoding template group.

UpdateVideoInfo.title: Modify single audio or video information
UpdateVideoInfo.summary: Modifies the information about a single audio or video file.

UpdateVideoInfos.title: Batch modify audio and video information
UpdateVideoInfos.summary: Modifies the information about multiple audio and video files at a time.

UpdateWatermark.title: Modify an image and text watermark template
UpdateWatermark.summary: Modifies the name and watermark configuration (WatermarkConfig) of an image and text watermark template that was added by calling the AddWatermark operation.

UploadMediaByURL.title: Pull and upload media files by URL in batches
UploadMediaByURL.summary: Pulls audio and video media files for upload based on source file URLs. Batch upload is supported.

UploadStreamByURL.title: Upload a transcoded stream by URL
UploadStreamByURL.summary: Uploads a transcoded stream file from external storage and mounts it to the corresponding ApsaraVideo VOD media asset.

VerifyVodDomainOwner.title: Verify domain name ownership
VerifyVodDomainOwner.summary: Calls this operation to verify domain name ownership.
